question: The Tapu dance from Arunachal Pradesh is performed by members of the ____________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adi Tribe.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Tapu dance:-**

 
 
• It is a traditional dance form of the Adi Tribe, which is one of the major tribes of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The dance is usually performed during festivals and other important occasions, and it is characterized by rhythmic movements and footwork.
 
• The dance is usually accompanied by traditional musical instruments such as drums, cymbals, and bamboo flutes.
 
 
 
• **Adi Tribe:-**
 
 
• It is known for their rich cultural heritage and traditional practices, and the Tapu dance is an important aspect of their cultural identity.
